Track: Coordination

## C EXPLICIT **P #778 RELEASE** — Stage2B2 post-BLIND precise source-coverage Gate0 then CONDITIONAL A-only backend repair (2026-10-23 JST)

**RELEASE EXACTLY THE SCOPE, NO-MERGE POLICY, TWO GATES AND STOP CONDITIONS IN [Issue #778](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/778).** This supersedes Issue-creation INTAKE HOLD for this P task only. **No blanket permission** to add H-arm T interleaving, new public joint issuer/semantic rights or to adopt the existing P candidate without independent evidence.

**Reverified immutable authority immediately before RELEASE:** current Compiler/main `168c1cdafe929051ef08ff58f858fab045b17763`, [CURRENT_SPEC](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/blob/main/docs/reference/CURRENT_SPEC.md) → canonical Draft17.34; predecessor [P DRAFT PR #775](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/pull/775) remains OPEN/DRAFT at head `96922455e18f0bd103c7bc7a208dbe915ed7ea98`, exact main base. Independent [R #776](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/776#issuecomment-6361332793) was **adjudicated COVERAGE FAIL and CLOSED as a completed independent test**, not a compiler fix; R DRAFT PR #777 remains unmerged, first source/oracle/hash and red fixed. Independent R same two actual CLI4 zero-C positives, first natural [FULL5 #39926815001](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/actions/runs/39926815001) 5×439/442 (same 3 R red, all baseline passes) + [PARTIAL #39926814953](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/actions/runs/39926814953) 438/441. All 6 test logs independently checked by C; no modifications or rerun. Source CHECK0 does not certify public H owner or T joint issuer.

**Gate0 MUST COME FIRST, READ-ONLY**: compare exact R frozen sources/byte hashes and the specific P #774 supported emitter profile; demonstrate exact first failing public-proof/backend predicate on R-A and R-B and provenance/world/Allocation/Domain/ValueFact origins, not inferred solely from CLI4. A starts with T prefix before H allocation but holds returned LiveTail in intermediate local and adds scoped read before terminal cleanup; B performs T changes after producer owner RETURN inside the H success arm. These are hypotheses from source comparison, not yet measured first rejection. Explain whether R-A's H local-owner RETURN and terminal caller are genuinely public-proven within one source (or not), identify necessary reusable backend handling, compare cost against leaving source safely unsupported. Document B's valid-but-unsupported after-owner H-arm interleaving as a separate v0 completion dependency, **NO B IMPLEMENTATION AUTHORIZED**. Post-first-pass reading R data by P is **NON-BLIND calibrated**, and may not modify/oracle-tune R evidence.

**Only IF** Gate0 shows a narrowly scoped, generalizable **backend-only** correction for A grounded entirely in existing genuine H/T source-issued authority, permit conditional Stage1 A repair on **NEW P branch from exact `96922455...`** (leave P #775 HEAD immutable), one stacked P-only **DRAFT / DO NOT MERGE PR**, focused strict C17 GCC/Clang O0/O2 native genuine two-H owner original ptr frees and T old/new/sibling, real 0/1/2 allocation failures, negative, selected reached OOM transaction and sanitizer. Freeze first diagnostic and new varied P-authored source/oracles separately, retain immutable R-A as explicitly nonblind calibrated regression; do not special-case source filename/literals or import foreign-world authority. After stable code/tests, one natural first-attempt FULL5+PARTIAL pair, expected old base FULL5 438 / PARTIAL 437 plus preregistered new K CTests; no weakened toolchain/CI/issuer/validator. On code/no-private-issuer failure, public proof mismatch, scope broadening or unsafe/loss of original physical identity ⇒ **STOP to C** without speculation or CI reruns. If Gate0 shows a new public issuer/ownership rule or a general CFG engine necessary, **STOP before writing implementation**; bring minimal trace and alternative designs to C for §4.2/§4.3/§4.3.2 gates.

**EXECUTION MODE: P's own Work/Codex-equivalent development environment + NEW dedicated P-only branch + local compiler/native validation + Github Actions only when stable amended candidate is ready. NOT normal Chat R workflow.** Do NOT modify fixed candidate P PR #775, R PR #777, main, canonical, initial R source+oracle, LLVM/toolchain, workflows or public checked-owned issuer. No R/M/F/other Track is auto-launched; only C may approve later independent non-blind calibrated revalidation/fresh R and merge.

**Goal/Evidence/Alternatives/STOP:** Increase ordinary v0 source-form native coverage rather than fixture-specific PASS; independent CHECK0/CLI4 is the new evidence and conservative fail-closed main is the current safe alternative. Narrow A proof-consuming backend development is conditioned on exact issuer continuity; B's required v0 completion scope remains recorded and cannot be silently dropped. **VALUE-ALIGNMENT-RISK** separate: no well-factored-C vs NewLang author+ordinary-safe caller UB-prevention audit/re-audit dependency closure measured, no Product GO. Product GO #624 PAUSED and H1 #268 HOLD.

At task start use [Project Compass](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/blob/main/docs/NewLang_Project_Compass.md) to find the relevant canonical goals/non-goals/alternatives; record any deviation warning separately in this Issue. Report exact Gate0 first refuser/proofs, code/no-code decision, source SHA and (if coded) PR/CI evidence; leave main merge and Issue closure to Coordination.
